name: @snippkit/mcp-server
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for SnippKit - Seamless integration with AI agents (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity, Windsurf) for Agent Skills, Code Snippets, and Shell Commands.
author: SnippKit

tools.name: snippkit_search_skills
tools.description: Search public and team AI Skills in the SnippKit registry by keywords or agent compatibility

tools.name: snippkit_get_skill
tools.description: Fetch complete SKILL.md instructions and procedural rules

tools.name: snippkit_save_skill
tools.description: Author or publish an AI agent skill directly to SnippKit registry

tools.name: snippkit_search_snippets
tools.description: Search your private and public code snippets by title, tag, or language

tools.name: snippkit_get_snippet
tools.description: Retrieve decrypted code from your SnippKit library

tools.name: snippkit_save_snippet
tools.description: Save newly written or refactored code directly into SnippKit

tools.name: snippkit_search_commands
tools.description: Search verified shell scripts and DevOps command runbooks

tools.name: snippkit_get_command
tools.description: Retrieve shell command scripts from a runbook

tools.name: snippkit_save_command
tools.description: Save a shell command, deployment script, or multi-step runbook directly into your SnippKit library
